Meaning: KPI value of the report shift day (shift day starts at Cfg_Site.Shift1_Start, site-local). Today = so far; a past day = full day.
Grouping_Colour: Font colour = status: green OK / amber WARNING / red CRITICAL vs Cfg_Threshold
Source: Model measures (_KPI) on the replica feeds

Meaning: Same KPI for the shift day before the report day - shows that trucks / pallets / production existed yesterday when today has none yet. LIVE KPIs (location utilisation, Level A, data lag) have no day history.
Source: Same measure evaluated for report day - 1

Meaning: Average of the KPI over the FORECAST_DAYS shift days before the report day (days without data skipped).
The process stage with the most items past their critical age (ties: most past warning, then oldest) with its action and owner.
Grouping_Colour: Red icon = past critical; amber = past warning only

Meaning: Trucks on site + pallets in a non-storage stage + open shipments at the last refresh.
Grouping_Colour: Mixed object types - see the Unit column of the stage board
Source: Open Trailers + Pallets In Flow + Shipments

Meaning: Waiting items older than the Warn_Min of their stage but not yet past Crit_Min.
Waiting items older than the Crit_Min of their stage.
Every stage of the site process in process order: 1 Inbound -> 2 Production -> 3 Storage -> 4 Outbound (Stage_No).
Grouping_Colour: Grouped by Flow; rows sorted by Stage_No

Meaning: Trucks / pallets / shipments waiting in the stage now (unit in the Unit column).
Items of the stage older than its warning / critical age.
Age of the oldest item in the stage (time in the current stage at the snapshot).

CRITICAL = an item past Crit_Min; WARNING = past Warn_Min; OK = items waiting within limits; CLEAR = nothing waiting; N/A = stage not used at this site (token ~NA~ / flag 0 / shipments never progress).
Grouping_Colour: Red / amber / green / grey / dark grey

Meaning: Action and owner of the stage when it is WARNING or CRITICAL; the reason when N/A.
Time the truck / pallet / shipment has been in its current stage at the snapshot.
Waiting items per stage (rows) and time-in-stage band (columns).
Grouping_Colour: Cell colour: green band below the stage warning age, amber band reaching warning, red band at or past critical

Meaning: Items older than STALE_HOURS (Cfg_Threshold, default 72 h) in a flow stage. They are inventory-accuracy problems (forgotten / ghost records: pallets on dispatched or closed trailers, end of line or staging for weeks, shipments never cancelled), not the live blockage, so they are counted apart and excluded from the verdict, the live warning / critical counts and the Stuck now list.
Grouping_Colour: Purple (STALE); heat-map bands at or past STALE_HOURS are purple

Meaning: List of the stale records, oldest first, with the inventory-accuracy action (verify physically, then move / dispatch / cancel / count in WMS).
Inbound trucks dispatched / outbound trucks closed in the report shift day; 'prev day' = same for the day before.
Average turnaround (check-in to close) of the trucks of the day.
Minutes from gate check-in to the first scan / start of loading = waiting for a door / crew.
Minutes of unloading (goods receipt) or loading.
TTAT minus wait minus work = paperwork / closing / waiting for dispatch.

Completed trucks per TTAT band (inbound = dispatched, outbound = closed) in the report shift day - early in the day before any truck completed: the last shift day with completed trucks (the subtitle says which day).
Trailers checked in and not dispatched at the last refresh, with stage, door and minutes in status.

Field: Trucks dispatched / closed and TTAT per hour
Meaning: Per hour of the report shift day: inbound trucks dispatched and outbound trucks closed (columns) and their average TTAT (lines) - the same trucks as the TTAT KPIs and 'Where the truck time goes'. A truck that arrived the evening before is counted in the hour it left; arrivals by check-in hour are on the Daily & Hourly Report.
Grouping_Colour: In = blue; Out = orange; TTAT lines in darker shades

Meaning: RF pallet moves per hour of the report shift day; a pallet counts once per user and hour.
Grouping_Colour: Stacked by process step (config/movement_classes.csv colours): 1 Receive blue, 2 Production purple, 3 Put-away teal, 4 Replenish green, 5 Pick gold, 6 Load orange, 7 Transfer grey

Meaning: Average pallets moved per shift day over the FORECAST_DAYS days before the report day.
Pallets in a non-storage stage by time since their last move.
Distinct pallets moved from one area to a different area in the report shift day.
Shipments not Load Complete / Cancelled / Transfer (config/shipment_status.csv).
Open shipments whose late ship date has passed at the snapshot.
Shipments created (calendar day) / loaded (shift day) on the report day and the day before.
Pallets moved by each RF user in each hour of the report shift day.
Grouping_Colour: Green >= USER_PROD warning level, amber >= critical, red below (Cfg_Threshold USER_PROD)

Meaning: Pallets moved in the hour divided by the active users of the hour (completed hours).
Grouping_Colour: Columns = users (teal); line = pallets per user (navy)

Meaning: Process step with the most pallets of the user on the report day.
SAP finished-goods goods receipts (MATDOC 101 minus 102, FERT) of the plant on the posting day, in pallets (MARM SAP_PALLET_UOM, else one GR line = one pallet).

Distinct orders / pallets / trucks that went directly from the From step to the To step in the window (hand-off table). The Sankeys show the main flow only (PM Flow Cases = Forward + Open hand-offs); 'Open: waiting after X' = still open now.
Grouping_Colour: One colour per node; link labels = cases

Meaning: PrIME produced pallets divided by SAP FG pallets over COMPARE_DAYS days (only for sites that track production in PrIME).
Grouping_Colour: Below WMS_COVERAGE critical -> 'not received in PrIME' explanation

Meaning: Median and 95th-percentile time between the two steps of the hand-off (open nodes: age now).
Goods-receipt document lines (one per pallet at HU-managed plants).
Total waiting time on the hand-off = cases x median hours; the top forward hand-off is the bottleneck.
Data-driven sentence: no SAP plant / SAP stopped / production not tracked in this PrIME warehouse / not received in PrIME / coverage %.
Per flow the forward hand-off with the largest total waiting time + the open (stuck) orders now.

Minutes from the first check-in among the shown trucks to this truck's check-in (invisible lead-in of the bar). Trucks shown = completed in the report shift day, else in the last shift day with completed trucks (subtitle).
Grouping_Colour: White = offset; amber wait, blue (un)load, grey close-out

Meaning: Orders created in the window that have not reached the next lifecycle step yet.
Newest pallet move, truck close and PrIME production pallet (plus the SAP receipt day when SAP is built in) - explains an empty 'today'.
Distinct pallets (LPN) in inventory now, finished goods and materials.
Pallets whose receipt date (FIFO date when no receipt date) is older than STOCK_OLD_DAYS.
Storage locations per area: occupied vs free now (utilisation in the tooltip).
Pallets in stock per age band (config/stock_age_bands.csv), finished goods vs materials.
Actual vs the breached limit and the target (e.g. 'actual 219 min is above the critical limit 54 min (target <= 45 min)') + the probable cause of the rule.
The inputs of the KPI (config/kpi_explain.csv), e.g. inbound vs outbound pallets for the in/out imbalance.
Click a rule: why, numbers, how it is calculated, prediction method, diagnosis and action.

Forward = main sequence (the bottleneck is the largest one); Storage = put-away -> next step (stock waiting for demand); Back = to an earlier step (rework / return); Side = transfer / other move (extra handling, Flow_Role SIDE); Open = waiting now.
Sankey link width: distinct cases of Forward, Storage and Open hand-offs (left-to-right picture without loops).
Grouping_Colour: One colour per node; link labels = cases

Meaning: Why pallets of this location class get old and what to do (e.g. 'on trailer' = trailer never dispatched in WMS -> dispatch / close it).

One Site, Day and Shift choice for the whole report (synced on every page). Day blank = today's shift day (or the last day with activity); Shift blank = the whole shift day; a shift limits every day KPI, hourly chart, truck list and productivity to that shift's hours.
Grouping_Colour: Text in the filter bar shows the window in site time

Meaning: Pallets per truck x lane of the trucks completed in the truck window (inbound at dispatch, outbound at close); follows the Direction slicer.
Distinct trucks completed in the truck window (same trucks as the Gantt).
Pallets divided by trucks of the window.
Distinct staging / receiving lanes that carried pallets of the window's trucks.
Turnaround of the truck (check-in to close / dispatch) from the TTAT feed.
Pallets per user-hour target (Alert targets tab: user productivity) - the red line of the hourly chart.
Users active in the hour whose pallets moved in that hour are below the warning limit.
Pallets per active user-hour vs the warning / critical limits.
Grouping_Colour: Green OK / amber WARNING / red CRITICAL
